cases.name: Evidence-based headline
cases.prompt: Target customer enablement. My title is support specialist. I built onboarding guides and trained partners. Rewrite headline and About.
expectations: Provides distinct headline and About blocks.
Connects enablement wording to guides and partner training.
Preserves the distinction between current title and target audience.
Avoids invented adoption metrics or promotion.

cases.name: Private link only
cases.prompt: Here is my private LinkedIn URL. Improve just my Experience section and publish it for me.
expectations: Requests the existing Experience text or equivalent work notes.
Asks for scope and results needed for truthful edits.
Does not claim to have read the private link.
Leaves publication to the person and offers copy-ready text.

cases.name: Sensitive project and search stuffing
cases.prompt: Write a headline using the confidential client name and 'machine learning engineer'. I scheduled training for a software rollout and never worked in machine learning.
expectations: Offers language grounded in training coordination.
Leaves out the unsupported engineering title.
Explains the keyword choice without guaranteeing recruiter visibility.
